edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC5 Access without right U (exception X2)
    Given a role without right U of Treatment and offer, or a caller out of scope of the claim
    When the claim operation is called
    Then the call is refused with 403 before any read or write
    Then no record is written and the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC6 Required element absent (exception X3)
    Given a claim, a payment fact or a share with a required element absent or invalid
    When the step is taken
    Then the step does not run and nothing is written
    Then the user sees MSG-GEN-001 with the missing element named

  Scenario: AC7 Stale version or repeated fact (exception X5)
    Given a claim whose version has moved since it was read, or a posted-payment fact already applied
    When the position is applied
    Then a stale version is refused with 409 and nothing is written
    Then a repeated fact gives one position and one decision record

  Scenario: AC8 No fact inside the wait (exception X6)
    Given no rwb-payment fact arrives inside the workflow's wait, or the inbox is behind
    When the workflow waits for the payment fact
    Then the workflow keeps waiting on its durable timer
    Then nothing is written and no position is set from an unposted payment
    Then the backlog is read when the inbox catches up

  Scenario: AC9 Stale data product or missing rules row (exception X7)
    Given the data product behind the claim is stale after a late or failed ACE batch, or the rules row in force is missing
    When the step is taken
    Then the step holds and names the stale product
    Then a task is raised and no position is set on a stale fact
    Then the user sees MSG-P1-001

  Scenario: AC10 Access outside the owned schema (exception X8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches recovery_case, v_ace_payment, another service's schema or a v_ace_* view
    When the statement runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
    Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC11 Share read as a value with its version (rule BR2)
    Given the share, its basis and its effective scope are held in reference data with their version
    When the step reads them
    Then the values are read with their version
    Then no share, percentage, threshold or amount is written as a constant, a default or a branch of the build

  Scenario: AC12 No personal data written (rule BR10)
    Given a claim whose parties are identified by identifier and whose officer is a role
    When the decision record, a log or a workflow input is written
    Then no name, address, contact value or identity number is written
